name: My Secret Admirer
source:
Ava received a note from a secret admirer. She doesn't know who it could be.

It couldn't be too obvious, right? 

[From [url=https://jlynn.itch.io/secret-admirer]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾娃收到了一張暗戀者寫來的紙條，卻猜不出是誰寫的。

答案總不至於太明顯吧？
